description: End-to-end migration of interconnect billing data and configurations between systems, including scoping, validation, transformation, trial runs, cutover, monitoring, and rollback.

migration_id.description: Unique identifier for a migration run or plan

batch_id.description: Identifier for a logical batch of migrated records

source_system.description: Identifier of the source billing or mediation system

target_system.description: Identifier of the target interconnect billing system

operator_id.description: Identifier of the carrier or operator (e.g., MNO, MVNO, wholesale partner)

migration_record_ref.description: Reference to a specific record in the migration context

source_key.description: Primary key or composite key representation in source system

target_key.description: Primary key in target system if mapped/created

time_window.description: Time window for scoping CDRs and related data

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: init_migration_plan
functions.description: Initialize a new interconnect migration plan, including scope, systems, and high-level options.

source_system.description: Source interconnect or legacy billing system identifier

operators.description: List of operators / carriers included in this migration

include_entities.description: Specific entities to migrate for this operator

plan_type.description: Indicates if this is a dry-run, pilot migration, or full cutover

data_domains.description: Data domains in scope for migration

constraints.description: Technical and business constraints to respect during migration

allow_partial_operators.description: Allow partial migration if some operators fail validation

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for this plan

requested_by.description: User or system initiating the migration

functions.returns: New migration plan with assigned migration_id, initial status, and summary of scope.

functions.name: define_migration_mapping
functions.description: Define or update entity and field-level mappings between source and target interconnect billing schemas.

entity_mappings.description: Mappings for each type of entity that will be migrated

source_collection.description: Table, topic, or collection name in the source system

target_collection.description: Table, topic, or collection name in the target system

field_mappings.description: Mappings between source and target fields, including transformation hints

params.description: Transform-specific parameters, e.g., scale factor, delimiter, lookup table ID

is_key.description: Marks field as part of record key for reconciliation

filters.description: Optional filter conditions on the source data for this entity

where_clause.description: Opaque filter expression understood by the connector, e.g. SQL WHERE fragment

version_label.description: Human-readable label or semantic version for this mapping definition

replace_existing.description: Whether to replace existing mappings for this migration_id

functions.returns: Mapping definition saved, including mapping version, validation hints, and potential issues.

functions.name: validate_source_data
functions.description: Run structural and business validations on source interconnect data before extraction.

entities.description: Subset of entities to validate; if omitted, all entities in plan are validated

sample_strategy.description: Defines whether validation is full or sample-based

sample_size.description: Number of records per entity to validate when mode=sample

stop_on_error_threshold.description: Thresholds at which validation should stop and mark migration as blocked

error_rate_percent.description: Maximum allowed percentage of invalid records per entity

max_critical_errors.description: Maximum allowed number of critical errors overall

functions.returns: Validation report with per-entity error statistics, sample errors, and readiness verdict.

functions.name: run_transformation_preview
functions.description: Preview transformed records for a small sample of source data to verify mapping correctness.

sample_criteria.description: Criteria for sampling source records to preview

include_diff.description: If true, computes structured diff between mapped fields and expected patterns

functions.returns: Sampled records with raw source payload, transformed payload, and field-level mapping diagnostics.

functions.name: start_migration_execution
functions.description: Start or resume the execution of a migration plan, creating batches and scheduling tasks.

execution_mode.description: Dry run writes to shadow structures only; full_cutover updates production target.

batching_strategy.description: Strategy for chunking data into batches

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency token to avoid starting the same execution twice

resume_from_checkpoint.description: If true, resume from last successful checkpoint for this migration_id

functions.returns: Execution handle with migration_id, initial batches created, and execution status.

functions.name: get_migration_status
functions.description: Retrieve real-time status of a migration execution, including per-batch progress and error counts.

batch_filters.description: Optional filters to narrow down batch details

functions.returns: Migration execution status including overall state, progress percentages, per-batch status, and key performance metrics.

functions.name: list_migration_batches
functions.description: List batches within a migration execution with pagination and filtering.
functions.returns: Paginated list of batches with status, counts, and basic metrics.

functions.name: retry_failed_batch
functions.description: Retry processing of a failed or partially failed migration batch with optional overrides.

override_transformations.description: Optional ad-hoc overrides for transformations during retry

field_path.description: Dot-notated path to field in the transformed record

default_value.description: Value to use when transformation fails

comment.description: Operational note describing why retry is being performed

functions.returns: Retry task created with updated batch status and reference to previous attempt.

functions.name: reconcile_migration_results
functions.description: Perform reconciliation between source and target for migrated interconnect data, focusing on financial and volume integrity.

scope.description: Defines which parts of migration to reconcile

volume_percentage.description: Allowed percentage difference in record counts

amount_percentage.description: Allowed percentage difference in rated amounts

max_absolute_amount.description: Absolute maximum difference in monetary units allowed

group_by_dimensions.description: Dimensions to group reconciliation metrics by

functions.returns: Reconciliation report with per-dimension metrics, discrepancies, and pass/fail verdict for migration.

functions.name: finalize_migration_cutover
functions.description: Finalize migration by switching interconnect billing operations fully to the target system, with optional graceful switchover.

switch_points.description: Optional detailed switch-over instructions for phased cutover

effective_time.description: When target system becomes authoritative for this slice

fallback_strategy.description: Defines how to handle issues after cutover

approval.description: Approval information for audit and governance

functions.returns: Cutover plan activation confirmation with updated migration state and active switch-points.

functions.name: cancel_migration
functions.description: Cancel a migration plan or execution, optionally performing cleanup and partial rollback.

rollback_options.description: Options for rollback if cancel_mode requires it

force.description: If true, attempts rollback even if some checkpoints are missing

functions.returns: Cancellation and optional rollback result, including which changes were reverted and which remain.

functions.name: rollback_migration_changes
functions.description: Perform an explicit rollback of previously applied migration changes for selected scopes.

rollback_scope.description: Defines what should be rolled back

batches.description: Optional list of batch_ids to rollback; if omitted, uses logical criteria below

confirm_revenue_impact.description: If true, caller asserts revenue impact has been evaluated

functions.returns: Rollback job details including affected records estimate, status, and any non-reversible items.

functions.name: get_migration_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve detailed audit trail for a migration, including configuration changes, batch events, and operator-level actions.

include_payloads.description: If true, include serialized before/after snapshots where available

functions.returns: Paginated audit log entries with timestamps, actors, event types, and optional payload snapshots.

functions.name: search_interconnect_migration_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across interconnect_migration entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching interconnect_migration entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_interconnect_migration_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N interconnect_migration records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_interconnect_migration_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many interconnect_migration records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_interconnect_migration_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many interconnect_migration records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_interconnect_migration_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of interconnect_migration data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_interconnect_migration_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a interconnect_migration dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_interconnect_migration_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more interconnect_migration entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_interconnect_migration_snapshot
functions.description: Restore interconnect_migration state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_interconnect_migration_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the interconnect_migration workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_interconnect_migration_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across interconnect_migration metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_interconnect_migration_audit_events
functions.description: Search the interconnect_migration audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_interconnect_migration_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers interconnect_migration workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_interconnect_migration_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for interconnect_migration events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_interconnect_migration_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for interconnect_migration events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_interconnect_migration_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off interconnect_migration job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_interconnect_migration_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled interconnect_migration jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_interconnect_migration_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled interconnect_migration job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_interconnect_migration_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a interconnect_migration operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_interconnect_migration_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a interconnect_migration action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_interconnect_migration_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a interconnect_migration approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_interconnect_migration_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any interconnect_migration entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_interconnect_migration_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a interconnect_migration entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_interconnect_migration_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling interconnect_migration behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_interconnect_migration_policies
functions.description: List interconnect_migration policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_interconnect_migration_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two interconnect_migration-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_interconnect_migration_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a interconnect_migration entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_interconnect_migration_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many interconnect_migration entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
